modules.role: the USB end: the Type-C receptacle with its two CC pulldowns (R1/R2), the VBUS reservoir C2 and the VBUS lamp D1+R3, drawn first because the reader enters the sheet from the connector side

the middle: the CH343G bridge U1 with its own-pin passives, C1 on VDD5 and C3 on the V3 regulator output; every signal it carries leaves this island for one of the other two, so the island's boundary nets are all cross-island labels
the far end: the 2x5 header carrying the eight UART/MODEM lines plus the VCC level rail and GND, where the peer board attaches

directWiringObligations.note: the USB data pair is a solid conductor from the receptacle's two DP/DN pin pairs to UD+/UD- of the bridge — no series resistor, no stub: the datasheet says the pins connect straight to the bus

the VBUS lamp's cathode and R3 are one conductor inside the usb_c island: labelPolicy.local is 'wire', so naming the lamp's return would be a label where the policy promises a wire (534; the pair is D1 pin 2 to R3 pin 1, nothing else on the net)
